DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		VALUES('dim_date'[Year])

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(101, __DS0Core, 'dim_date'[Year], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	'dim_date'[Year]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('dim_date'[Year])),
			NOT('dim_date'[Year] IN {2019})
		)

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'dim_department'[department_group],
			__DS0FilterTable,
			"Active_Employee_Headcount", '_Measures'[Active Employee Headcount]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Active_Employee_Headcount], 0, 'dim_department'[department_group], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[Active_Employee_Headcount] DESC, 'dim_department'[department_group]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('dim_date'[Year])),
			NOT('dim_date'[Year] IN {2019})
		)

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'dim_date'[Month Name],
			'dim_date'[Month Number],
			__DS0FilterTable,
			"Terminations", '_Measures'[Terminations],
			"New_Hires__Snapshot_Period_", '_Measures'[New Hires (Snapshot Period)]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, 'dim_date'[Month Number], 0, 'dim_date'[Month Name], 0)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	'dim_date'[Month Number] DESC, 'dim_date'[Month Name] DESC

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('dim_date'[Year])),
			NOT('dim_date'[Year] IN {2019})
		)

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'dim_date'[Year],
			__DS0FilterTable,
			"Active_Employee_Headcount", '_Measures'[Active Employee Headcount]
		)

	VAR __DS0IntersectionCount = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(__DS0Core))

	VAR __DS0BodyBinnedSample = 
		SAMPLEAXISWITHLOCALMINMAX(
			3500,
			__DS0Core,
			'dim_date'[Year],
			[Active_Employee_Headcount],
			350,
			,
			ALPHABETICAL,
			ASC,
			105000,
			60
		)

EVALUATE
	ROW(
	"DS0IntersectionCount", __DS0IntersectionCount
)

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyBinnedSample

ORDER BY
	'dim_date'[Year]
